findings.mechanism: Static ConcurrentHashMap AWAITING gets an entry (ticketId -> PendingCharge, which holds the full ChargeRequest incl. email/account/invoice) on every ChargeService.charge() (ChargeService.java:26). The only removal is InFlightCharges.complete(), called solely from ChargeListener.onPosted (ChargeListener.java:20). onRejected and onExpired only bump notifier counters and never call complete(), so declined/expired charges stay in the map forever; also any charge whose callback never arrives, or if submit() throws after register (ChargeService.java:26-27).
findings.cause: Missing InFlightCharges.complete(ticket.id()) on the onRejected/onExpired paths (and no failure cleanup or TTL/eviction); oldestAgeMillis() would reveal the stale entries.
